-- Pure durable state transitions. Caller supplies server clock and unique IDs.
local Config = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Config.StrengthRewardConfig)
local M = {}
local function number(v) return type(v) == "number" and v == v and v >= 0 and v < math.huge end
local function copy(v)
	if type(v) ~= "table" then return v end
	local out = {} for k, x in pairs(v) do out[k] = copy(x) end return out
end
M.Copy = copy
-- Only newly quoted packs use this final rounding; saved intents remain exact.
function M.PackAmount(rate, seconds)
 assert(number(rate) and number(seconds), "InvalidStrengthQuote")
 local amount=rate*seconds
 assert(number(amount), "InvalidStrengthQuote")
 return math.floor(amount)
end
function M.Normalize(raw)
	if raw == nil then return {Version = 2, Rewards = {}, Pending = {}, Receipts = {}, GrantedTotal = 0} end
	if type(raw) ~= "table" or (raw.Version ~= 1 and raw.Version ~= 2) or not number(raw.GrantedTotal)
		or type(raw.Rewards) ~= "table" or type(raw.Pending) ~= "table" or type(raw.Receipts) ~= "table" then return nil, "InvalidStrengthRewards" end
	for id, r in pairs(raw.Rewards) do
		if type(id) ~= "string" or type(r) ~= "table" or not number(r.Amount) or not number(r.Paid)
			or r.Paid > r.Amount * 2 or not number(r.CreatedAt) then return nil, "InvalidOfflineReward" end
	end
	for id, p in pairs(raw.Pending) do
		if type(id) ~= "string" or type(p) ~= "table" or not Config.ForProduct(p.ProductId)
			or type(p.Id) ~= "string" or not number(p.Amount) or p.Amount <= 0
			or (p.Kind ~= "Pack" and p.Kind ~= "DoubleOffline") then return nil, "InvalidStrengthIntent" end
		if p.Kind == "DoubleOffline" and (not raw.Rewards[p.RewardId] or raw.Rewards[p.RewardId].Amount ~= p.Amount) then return nil, "InvalidRewardBinding" end
	end
	for id, r in pairs(raw.Receipts) do
		if type(id) ~= "string" or type(r) ~= "table" or not Config.ForProduct(r.ProductId)
			or type(r.IntentId) ~= "string" or not number(r.Gain) then return nil, "InvalidStrengthReceipt" end
	end
	if raw.Presence then
		local p = raw.Presence
		if type(p) ~= "table" or not number(p.At)
			or (p.State ~= "Online" and p.State ~= "Offline") then return nil, "InvalidStrengthPresence" end
		if p.Basis == "DepartureStrengthV1" then
			if not number(p.Strength) then return nil, "InvalidDepartureStrength" end
		elseif p.Basis ~= nil or not number(p.Rate) then return nil, "InvalidStrengthPresence" end
	end
	local state = copy(raw)
	state.Version = 2 -- Migrate the envelope only; paid amounts/bindings stay exact.
	return state
end
function M.Acquire(raw, token, now)
	local state = assert(M.Normalize(raw))
	if state.Owner == token then return state end -- ambiguous acquisition retry
	-- A login replaces the free reward. Keep old records only while an immutable
	-- paid intent still needs them; receipts and their deduplication journal survive.
	local retained = {}
	for _, intent in pairs(state.Pending) do
		if intent.Kind == "DoubleOffline" then retained[intent.RewardId] = true end
	end
	for id in pairs(state.Rewards) do if not retained[id] then state.Rewards[id] = nil end end
	local p = state.Presence
	if p and p.State == "Offline" and p.Basis == "DepartureStrengthV1" then
		-- Only a confirmed departure proves this interval was offline. An expired
		-- heartbeat cannot prove a prior server stopped; never infer that interval.
		local start = p.At
		local seconds = Config.OfflineSeconds(math.max(0, now - start))
		local amount = Config.OfflineAmount(p.Strength, seconds)
		if amount > 0 then state.Rewards[token] = {Amount = amount, Paid = 0, CreatedAt = now, Seconds = seconds} end
	end
	-- Legacy Rate is equipment gain/second, never departure Strength. Without a
	-- proven snapshot the first migrated login earns zero; the next confirmed exit
	-- establishes the new basis. Old paid intents above remain payable unchanged.
	state.Owner = token
	state.Presence = {State = "Online", At = now, Basis = "DepartureStrengthV1", Strength = 0}
	return state
end
function M.Checkpoint(raw, token, now, strength, closing)
	local state = assert(M.Normalize(raw))
	assert(state.Owner == token, "StrengthOwnerMismatch")
	assert(number(strength), "InvalidDepartureStrength")
	state.Presence = {State = closing and "Offline" or "Online", At = now, Basis = "DepartureStrengthV1", Strength = strength}
	return state
end
function M.NextReward(state)
	-- Rewards are keyed by the acquisition token. Archived paid intents must never
	-- become the current free reward, including when this login earned zero.
	local id = state.Owner
	local reward = id and state.Rewards[id]
	if reward and reward.Paid < reward.Amount then return id, reward end
end
function M.Apply(raw, op)
	local state = assert(M.Normalize(raw))
	if state.LastOperation and state.LastOperation.Id == op.Id then return state, 0, "AlreadyApplied" end
	local gain = 0
	if op.Action == "Claim" then
		local r = state.Rewards[op.RewardId]
		if op.RewardId ~= state.Owner or not r then return nil, 0, "RewardUnavailable" end
		gain = math.max(0, r.Amount - r.Paid)
		r.Paid += gain
	elseif op.Action == "Prepare" then
		local product, kind = Config.ForProduct(op.ProductId)
		if not product then return nil, 0, "ProductUnavailable" end
		if kind == "DoubleOffline" and (op.RewardId ~= state.Owner or not state.Rewards[op.RewardId]) then return nil, 0, "RewardUnavailable" end
		local key = tostring(op.ProductId)
		local previous = state.Pending[key]
		if previous then
			-- Never resume an older reward's checkout from this login's popup.
			if previous.Kind == "DoubleOffline" and previous.RewardId ~= op.RewardId then return nil, 0, "PurchasePending" end
			-- A cancelled dialog cannot prove the absence of a delayed receipt.
			-- Retain and resume the same quote; never bind that receipt to a newer one.
			if previous.State ~= "Cancelled" and previous.State ~= "Prepared" then return nil, 0, "PurchasePending" end
			if previous.Kind == "DoubleOffline" and state.Rewards[previous.RewardId].Paid >= previous.Amount then return nil, 0, "RewardUnavailable" end
			previous.State = "Prepared"
			state.LastOperation = {Id = op.Id, Gain = 0}
			return state, 0, "Committed"
		end
		local amount = op.Amount
		if kind == "DoubleOffline" then
			local r = state.Rewards[op.RewardId]
			if not r or r.Paid >= r.Amount then return nil, 0, "RewardUnavailable" end
			amount = r.Amount
		end
		if not number(amount) then return nil, 0, "InvalidAmount" end
		if kind == "Pack" then amount = M.PackAmount(amount, 1) end
		if amount <= 0 then return nil, 0, "InvalidAmount" end
		state.Pending[key] = {Id = op.Id, ProductId = op.ProductId, Kind = kind, Amount = amount, RewardId = op.RewardId, State = "Prepared"}
	elseif op.Action == "Open" then
		local p = state.Pending[tostring(op.ProductId)]
		if not p or p.Id ~= op.IntentId or p.State ~= "Prepared" then return nil, 0, "PurchasePending" end
		if p.Kind == "DoubleOffline" and p.RewardId ~= state.Owner then return nil, 0, "RewardUnavailable" end
		p.State = "Prompting"
	elseif op.Action == "Cancel" then
		local key = tostring(op.ProductId)
		local p = state.Pending[key]
		if p and p.Id == op.IntentId then p.State = "Cancelled" end
	elseif op.Action == "Receipt" then
		local seen = state.Receipts[op.PurchaseId]
		if seen then
			if seen.ProductId ~= op.ProductId then return nil, 0, "ReceiptMismatch" end
			return state, 0, "AlreadyGranted"
		end
		local key = tostring(op.ProductId)
		local p = state.Pending[key]
		if not p or p.Id ~= op.IntentId then return nil, 0, "UnmatchedReceipt" end
		if p.Kind == "Pack" then gain = p.Amount
		else
			local r = state.Rewards[p.RewardId]
			if not r or r.Amount ~= p.Amount then return nil, 0, "RewardMismatch" end
			gain = math.max(0, p.Amount * 2 - r.Paid)
			r.Paid += gain
		end
		state.Receipts[op.PurchaseId] = {ProductId = op.ProductId, IntentId = p.Id, RewardId = p.RewardId, Gain = gain}
		state.Pending[key] = nil
	else return nil, 0, "InvalidOperation" end
	state.GrantedTotal += gain
	state.LastOperation = {Id = op.Id, Gain = gain}
	return state, gain, "Committed"
end
return M

-- Per-session fencing for every normal PlayerData write, on the same key.
local ReturnPersistence = require(script.Parent.RunReturnPersistence)
local M = {}
local StrengthRewards = require(script.Parent.StrengthRewardState)
local AdminWin = require(script.Parent.ProductionWinState)

function M.Acquire(store, key, attempt, defaults, validate, current)
	if attempt.Lost then error("SessionOwnershipLost", 0) end
	if not attempt.Read then
		local options = Instance.new("DataStoreGetOptions")
		options.UseCache = false
		local raw = store:GetAsync(key, options)
		assert(raw == nil or typeof(raw) == "table", "Invalid saved PlayerData")
		attempt.InitiallyMissing = raw == nil
		attempt.ExpectedOwner = raw and raw.SessionOwnerToken
		attempt.Read = true
	end
	attempt.StrengthNow = attempt.StrengthNow or os.time()
	local rejected = false
	local saved = store:UpdateAsync(key, function(old, info)
		rejected = false
		assert(old == nil or typeof(old) == "table", "Invalid saved PlayerData")
		local owner = old and old.SessionOwnerToken
		if not current() or owner ~= attempt.ExpectedOwner and owner ~= attempt.Token then
			rejected = true
			return nil
		end
		local normalized, reason = validate(old)
		assert(normalized, reason)
		-- Transient provenance only; never emit analytics inside UpdateAsync.
		if old==nil then attempt.ProfileKind=attempt.InitiallyMissing and "New" or "Unknown"
		elseif owner~=attempt.Token or attempt.ProfileKind==nil then attempt.ProfileKind="Existing" end
		local data = old and table.clone(old) or defaults()
		-- Normalize legacy item quantities before any durable delta operation.
		data.OwnedItems = table.clone(normalized.OwnedItems)
		ReturnPersistence.Recover(data)
		data.StrengthRewards = StrengthRewards.Acquire(data.StrengthRewards, attempt.Token, attempt.StrengthNow)
		data = AdminWin.Acquire(data, attempt.Token)
		data.SessionOwnerToken = attempt.Token
		local meta = info and info:GetMetadata() or {}
		local j = data.RunReturnJournal
		if j and j.State == "Cancelled" and old.RunReturnJournal.State == "Pending" then
			meta.RunReturnId, meta.RunReturnState = j.TransactionId, "Cancelled"
		end
		return data, info and info:GetUserIds() or {}, meta
	end)
	if rejected then attempt.Lost = true; error("SessionOwnershipLost", 0) end
	assert(saved and saved.SessionOwnerToken == attempt.Token, "OwnershipSaveUnconfirmed")
	return saved
end

function M.Update(store, key, session, transform, current)
	if session.OwnershipLost or not session.OwnerToken or not current() then error("SessionOwnershipLost", 0) end
	local rejected = false
	local saved, info = store:UpdateAsync(key, function(old, keyInfo)
		rejected = false
		if not current() or typeof(old) ~= "table" or old.SessionOwnerToken ~= session.OwnerToken then
			rejected = true
			return nil
		end
		local value, users, meta = transform(old, keyInfo)
		if value then assert(value.SessionOwnerToken == session.OwnerToken, "Owner token must be preserved") end
		return value, users, meta
	end)
	if rejected then session.OwnershipLost = true; error("SessionOwnershipLost", 0) end
	return saved, info
end

return M

local Analytics=require(game.ServerScriptService.Services.FirstPlayAnalyticsService)
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local Data=require(game.ServerScriptService.Services:WaitForChild("PlayerDataService"))
local AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL=90
local MAX_CONCURRENT_SAVES=6
local winConnections=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})

local function load(player)
 for attempt=1,3 do
  local ok=Data.Load(player)
  if ok then return true end
  task.wait(attempt)
 end
 Analytics.LoadFailed(player)
 warn("PlayerData unavailable for "..player.Name.."; session will not be saved")
 return false
end

local function bindWin(player)
 if winConnections[player] then return end
 winConnections[player]=player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Win"):Connect(function()
  if Data.IsLoaded(player) then
   Data.SetWin(player,player:GetAttribute("Win"))
  end
 end)
end

local function saveLatest(player,timeout)
 local deadline=os.clock()+(timeout or 30)
 if not require(game.ServerScriptService.Services.RunItemBankService).Flush(player,timeout or 30) then return false end
 for attempt=1,3 do
  Data.WaitForSave(player,math.max(0,deadline-os.clock()))
  local ok=Data.Save(player)
  local session=Data.Get(player)
  if not session or not session.Loaded then return end
  if ok and not session.Dirty then return end
  if os.clock()>=deadline then return end
  task.wait(0.05)
 end
end

local function saveBounded(players,timeout,flush)
 local total=#players
 if total==0 then return true end
 local nextIndex=0
 local completed=0
 local workers=math.min(MAX_CONCURRENT_SAVES,total)
 local function worker()
  while true do
   nextIndex+=1
   local index=nextIndex
   local player=players[index]
   if not player then return end
   if Data.IsLoaded(player) then
    if flush then Data.PrepareStrengthDeparture(player);saveLatest(player,timeout or 30)
    else Data.Save(player);Data.WaitForSave(player,timeout or 30) end
   end
   completed+=1
  end
 end
 for _=1,workers do task.spawn(worker) end
 local deadline=os.clock()+(timeout or 30)+math.ceil(total/workers)*10
 while completed<total and os.clock()<deadline do task.wait(0.05) end
 return completed>=total
end

local function currentPlayers()
 local result={}
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
  if Data.IsLoaded(player) then result[#result+1]=player end
 end
 return result
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
 Analytics.Join(player)
 bindWin(player)
 task.spawn(load,player)
end)
for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
 Analytics.Join(player)
 bindWin(player)
 task.spawn(load,player)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
 Analytics.Leaving(player)
 local c=winConnections[player]
 if c then c:Disconnect(); winConnections[player]=nil end
 if Data.IsLoaded(player) then
  Data.PrepareStrengthDeparture(player)
  saveLatest(player,30)
 end
 local bank=require(game.ServerScriptService.Services.RunItemBankService)
 if bank.Flush(player,0) then Data.Release(player)
 else task.spawn(function()
  while Data.IsLoaded(player) and not bank.Flush(player,10) do task.wait(1) end
  if Data.IsLoaded(player) then saveLatest(player,30);Data.Release(player) end
 end) end
end)

task.spawn(function()
 while true do
  task.wait(AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL)
  saveBounded(currentPlayers(),30)
 end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
 saveBounded(currentPlayers(),30,true)
end)

local panel, row = RewardUI.Build(gui)
local remote = RS.Remotes:WaitForChild("StrengthRewards")
local prices, closed, busy, view = {}, {}, false, nil
local alive = true
local viewRevision, activeClaim = 0, nil
local claimTitle = panel.Claim.Title.Text
-- The existing HP display is Roblox CoreGui. Replace that one display with the
-- same Humanoid values; HUDLayout exclusively owns the replacement's geometry.
local health = gui.StrengthLevelHUD:WaitForChild("PlayerHealth")
local healthConnections = {}
local function clearHealth()
	for _, connection in ipairs(healthConnections) do connection:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(healthConnections)
end
local function bindHealth(character)
	clearHealth()
	local hum = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	if not alive or player.Character ~= character or not hum then return end
	local function render()
		Presentation.SetFill(health, hum.MaxHealth > 0 and hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth or 0)
		health.Exp.Text = Presentation.Number(hum.Health) .. "/" .. Presentation.Number(hum.MaxHealth)
	end
	table.insert(healthConnections, hum.HealthChanged:Connect(render))
	table.insert(healthConnections, hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MaxHealth"):Connect(render))
	render()
end
local healthAdded = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(bindHealth)
local healthRemoving = player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(clearHealth)
if player.Character then task.spawn(bindHealth, player.Character) end
task.spawn(function()
	for _ = 1, 10 do
		if not alive then return end
		if pcall(function() game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Health, false) end) then return end
		task.wait(.5)
	end
end)
local function request(action, value, quiet, token)
	local ok, result = pcall(remote.InvokeServer, remote, action, value, token)
	if ok and type(result)=="table" then
		if not quiet and action~="View" and result.Ok==false then Feedback.Denied(result.Code) end
	end
	return ok and type(result) == "table" and result or {Ok = false, Code = "Retry"}
end
local function paint()
	if not view then return end
	local reward = view.Reward
	panel.Visible = reward ~= nil and not closed[reward.Id]
	if reward then
		panel.Title.Text = RewardUI.DurationTitle(reward.Seconds)
		panel.Amount.Text = "+" .. Format.Format(reward.Amount) .. " STRENGTH"
	end
	panel.Claim.Title.Text = activeClaim and "Claiming..." or claimTitle
	panel.Claim.Button.Active = not busy
	panel.Double.Button.Active = not busy and reward ~= nil and not view.Pending and prices[Config.DoubleOffline.ProductId] ~= nil
	for _, product in ipairs(Config.Packs) do
		local card = row[tostring(product.ProductId)]
		card.Amount.Text = "+" .. Presentation.Number(view.Offers[tostring(product.ProductId)] or 0)
		card.Purchase.Active = not busy and view.Ready and not view.Pending and prices[product.ProductId] ~= nil
	end
end
local function applyView(result)
	if not alive or not result.Offers or result.SessionToken ~= player:GetAttribute("ForgeSessionToken") then return false end
	view = result
	Feedback.ObserveStrength(result)
	paint()
	return true
end
local function refresh()
	if not alive or activeClaim then return end
	viewRevision += 1
	local version = viewRevision
	local result = request("View")
	if version == viewRevision and not activeClaim then applyView(result) end
end
local retryable = {Busy=true, DataSaving=true, InventorySavePending=true, Retry=true}
local function claim()
	if busy or not view or not view.Reward then return end
	local token = {RewardId=view.Reward.Id, Session=view.SessionToken}
	if token.Session ~= player:GetAttribute("ForgeSessionToken") then return end
	activeClaim=token; busy=true; viewRevision+=1; paint()
	local function current()
		return alive and activeClaim==token and token.Session==player:GetAttribute("ForgeSessionToken")
	end
	local failure = "Retry"
	local deadline = os.clock()+45
	for attempt=1,10 do
		if not current() or os.clock()>=deadline then break end
		-- A lost RemoteFunction response must not leave input locked forever.
		local result, completed
		task.spawn(function() result=request("Claim",token.RewardId,true,token.Session); completed=true end)
		local responseDeadline=math.min(deadline,os.clock()+10)
		repeat task.wait(.05) until completed or not current() or os.clock()>=responseDeadline
		if not current() then return end
		result=completed and result or {Ok=false,Code="Retry"}
		if result.Ok and result.View and applyView(result.View) then
			closed[token.RewardId]=true
			failure=nil
			break
		end
		failure=result.Code or "Retry"
		if not retryable[failure] then break end
		local untilTime=math.min(deadline,os.clock()+math.min(2,.5*2^(attempt-1)))
		repeat task.wait(.05) until not current() or os.clock()>=untilTime
	end
	if not current() then return end
	activeClaim=nil; busy=false; paint()
	if failure then Feedback.Denied(failure); task.defer(refresh) end
end
local function purchase(id)
	if busy or not view or view.Pending or not prices[id] then return end
	if id == Config.DoubleOffline.ProductId and not view.Reward then return end
	busy = true; paint()
	local result = request("Prepare", id)
	if result.Ok then
		if result.RewardId then panel.Amount.Text = "+" .. Format.Format(result.Amount) .. " STRENGTH"
		else row[tostring(id)].Amount.Text = "+" .. Presentation.Number(result.Amount) end
		-- The displayed amount is the persisted server quote before native checkout.
		request("Open", {ProductId = id, IntentId = result.IntentId})
	end
	busy = false; refresh()
end

panel.Double.Button.Activated:Connect(function() purchase(Config.DoubleOffline.ProductId) end)

local function fetchPrice(product, button)
	if product.ProductId <= 0 then return end
	local ok, info = pcall(Marketplace.GetProductInfoAsync, Marketplace, product.ProductId, Enum.InfoType.Product)
	-- Client lookup uses the same player context as regional/personalized checkout.
	if ok and type(info) == "table" and info.IsForSale == true and type(info.PriceInRobux) == "number" then
		prices[product.ProductId] = info.PriceInRobux
		if product.ProductId == Config.DoubleOffline.ProductId then
			Presentation.OfflinePrice(panel, info.PriceInRobux)
		end
		-- Main pack cards are a single input; official price remains on native checkout.
		button:SetAttribute("PriceInRobux",info.PriceInRobux)
		paint()
	end
end

local M = {}
function M.DurationTitle(seconds)
	if type(seconds) ~= "number" then return "OFFLINE REWARDS" end
	seconds = Config.OfflineSeconds(seconds)
	local hours = seconds / 3600
	local duration = hours >= 1 and string.format("%.2f", hours):gsub("0+$", ""):gsub("%.$", "")
		or string.format("%.2f", seconds / 60):gsub("0+$", ""):gsub("%.$", "")
	local unit = hours >= 1 and (hours == 1 and "Hour" or "Hours") or (seconds == 60 and "Minute" or "Minutes")
	return duration .. " " .. unit .. " of Offline Rewards"
end
local mounted=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
local function make(class, name, parent, properties)
	local x = Instance.new(class); x.Name = name
	for k, v in pairs(properties or {}) do x[k] = v end
	x.Parent = parent; return x
end
function M.Build(gui)
	local existing = gui:FindFirstChild("OfflineRewards")
	if existing then
		local row=gui.StrengthLevelHUD.StrengthPacks
		Presentation.Apply(gui)
		Layout.Mount(gui).Refresh()
		mounted[gui]=true

local function writeFreshReset(userId,fresh,targetStore,ownerSession,ownerPlayer)
 local saved
 local destination=targetStore or store
 local resetOwner=ownerSession and ownerSession.OwnerToken or HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  local function transform(old,info)
   local users,meta=metadata(info)
   local merged=typeof(old)=="table" and table.clone(old) or {}
   for field,value in pairs(fresh) do
    merged[field]=typeof(value)=="table" and table.clone(value) or value
   end
   merged.AdminWin=nil -- Explicit reset cancels any older administrative Win request.
   merged.ResetToken=fresh.ResetToken
   merged.SessionOwnerToken=resetOwner
   merged.RunReturnJournal=nil;merged.RunOreReturnJournal=nil
   meta.RunReturnId=nil;meta.RunReturnState=nil;meta.ItemMutationId=nil
   return merged,users,meta
  end
  if ownerSession then
   saved=Ownership.Update(destination,keyForUserId(userId),ownerSession,transform,
    function() return sessions[ownerPlayer]==ownerSession end)
  else
   -- Explicit administrative reset revokes any former session, as ResetToken did.
   saved=destination:UpdateAsync(keyForUserId(userId),transform)
  end
 end)
 if not ok then return false,tostring(err) end
 return true,saved
end

function PlayerDataService.Reset(player)

 local userId=player.UserId
 if resetByUserIdBusy[userId] then return false,"ResetBusy" end
 resetByUserIdBusy[userId]=true
 local fresh=freshResetData()
 s.Saving=true
 s.Loaded=false
 local ok,saved=writeFreshReset(userId,fresh,nil,s,player)
 if not ok then
  s.Loaded=true
  s.Saving=false
  resetByUserIdBusy[userId]=nil

 end

 -- just as writeFreshReset preserves it on disk. Do not leave that session field nil.

 resetByUserIdBusy[userId]=nil

function PlayerDataService.Load(player)

 if s and s.Loaded then return true,s.Data end
 if s and s.Loading then return false,"DataLoading" end
 if not s then
  local token=HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
  s={Loaded=false,Data=nil,Saving=false,OwnerToken=token,ReturnSequence=0,
   AcquireAttempt={Token=token}}
  sessions[player]=s
 end
 -- Joining never resumes a saved ON state, including while acquisition yields.
 player:SetAttribute("AutoTapEnabled",false)
 s.Loading=true
 -- The same acquisition attempt survives an ambiguous response. It may not
 -- steal ownership back if a different server acquired this key meanwhile.
 local ok,raw=pcall(Ownership.Acquire,store,key(player),s.AcquireAttempt,defaults,normalize,
  function() return sessions[player]==s end)
 if sessions[player]~=s then return false,"LoadSuperseded" end
 s.Loading=false
 if not ok then
  if tostring(raw)=="SessionOwnershipLost" then s.OwnershipLost=true end
  return false,"DataStore load failed: "..tostring(raw)
 end
 local d,validationError=normalize(raw)
 if not d then return false,validationError end
 d.AutoTapEnabled=false
 s.AdminWinAppliedId=AdminWin.AppliedId(raw)
 s.Loaded=true;s.Data=d;s.Dirty=true;s.LastSave=nil;s.TimeRewardClock=os.clock()
 applyAttributes(player,d)
 Analytics.Loaded(player,d,s.AcquireAttempt.ProfileKind)
 -- Recover the historical completion badge independently of the Studio arrival preview.
 if not d.World1Cleared then
  if player:GetAttribute("WorldComplete")==true then PlayerDataService.MarkWorld1Cleared(player) end
  task.defer(function()
   local badges=game:GetService("BadgeService")
   local id=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Config.BadgeConfig).GetBadgeId("World1Complete")
   for attempt=1,3 do
    if sessions[player]~=s or s.Data~=d or not s.Loaded or player.Parent~=Players or d.World1Cleared then return end
    local success,owned=pcall(badges.UserHasBadgeAsync,badges,player.UserId,id)
    if sessions[player]~=s or s.Data~=d or not s.Loaded then return end
    if success then if owned then PlayerDataService.MarkWorld1Cleared(player) end;return end
    task.wait(attempt)
   end
  end)
 end
 -- A Gate unlock is not arrival. Existing IntoWorld2 badges were awarded only
 -- after successful server travel; ownership alone is never migration proof.
 if not studioArrivalPreview and not d.World2Visited then
  task.defer(function()
   local function current() return sessions[player]==s and s.Data==d and s.Loaded and player.Parent==Players end
   if not current() then return end
   if player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")==2 then PlayerDataService.MarkWorld2Reached(player);return end
   local badges=game:GetService("BadgeService")
   local id=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Config.BadgeConfig).GetBadgeId("IntoWorld2")
   for attempt=1,3 do
    if not current() or d.World2Visited then return end
    local success,owned=pcall(badges.UserHasBadgeAsync,badges,player.UserId,id)
    if not current() then return end
    if success then if owned then PlayerDataService.MarkWorld2Reached(player) end;return end
    task.wait(attempt)
   end
   -- Failed proof lookup never grants access or clears a successful arrival.
  end)
 end
 return true,d
end

function PlayerDataService.SetWin(player,value)

 if not s or not s.Loaded then return false end
 local n=tonumber(value)
 if not finite(n) then return false end
 -- A capacity/Pet write may have committed even if its response was lost. Do not
 -- spend the same balance elsewhere while its receipt is unresolved; rewards
 -- can still increase Win and are retained when the purchase is acknowledged.
 if s.PendingAdminWin and n<s.Data.Win then return false end
 if s.PendingItemMutation and (s.PendingItemMutation.SizeChange or s.PendingItemMutation.CapacityUpgrade or s.PendingItemMutation.SpeedUpgrade or s.PendingItemMutation.PetMutation or s.PendingItemMutation.ForgeMutation) and n<s.Data.Win then return false end
 s.Data.Win=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Modules.WinAmount).Normalize(n)
 player:SetAttribute("Win",s.Data.Win)
 s.Dirty=true
 return true
end

 local rewardPresence=StrengthRewardState.Checkpoint(d.StrengthRewards,s.OwnerToken,s.StrengthDepartureTime or os.time(),departureStrength,s.StrengthClosing==true).Presence

local ITEM_MUTATION_RETRY_DELAYS={1,2,4,8}

local function scheduleItemMutationRetry(player,session,operation)
 if operation.RetryScheduled or operation.RetryExhausted then return nil,nil end
 local nextAttempt=(operation.RetryCount or 0)+1
 local delaySeconds=ITEM_MUTATION_RETRY_DELAYS[nextAttempt]
 if not delaySeconds then
  operation.RetryExhausted=true
  return nil,nil
 end
 operation.RetryScheduled=true
 task.delay(delaySeconds,function()
  if player.Parent~=Players or sessions[player]~=session or session.PendingItemMutation~=operation then
   operation.RetryScheduled=false
   return
  end
  operation.RetryScheduled=false
  if operation.Resolving then return end
  operation.RetryCount=nextAttempt
  PlayerDataService.ResolveItemMutation(player)
 end)
 return delaySeconds,nextAttempt
end

-- Size selection uses the existing write gate/retry lifecycle. The receipt is
-- durable so acknowledgement loss cannot undo the selection or debit twice.
local function resolveSizeChange(player,s,op)
 if op.Resolving then return false,"InventorySavePending" end
 op.Resolving=true;s.Saving=true
 local rejection
 local ok,saved=pcall(function()
  return ownedUpdate(player,s,function(old,info)
   rejection=nil
   if resetToken(old)~=op.ResetToken then rejection="SaveSupersededByReset";return nil end
   local oldTier=assert(SizeChangeConfig.NormalizeSavedTier(old.SelectedSizeTier))
   local users,meta=metadata(info)
   if old.SizeChangeOperationId==op.Id and oldTier==op.Tier then return old,users,meta end
   if oldTier~=op.CurrentTier then rejection="SizeSelectionChanged";return nil end
   local merged=table.clone(old)
   merged.SelectedSizeTier=op.Tier
   merged.Win=op.WinBefore-op.PriceWin
   merged.SizeChangeOperationId=op.Id
   return merged,users,meta
  end)
 end)
 op.Resolving=false;s.Saving=false
 if sessions[player]~=s or s.PendingItemMutation~=op then return false,"SaveSuperseded" end
 if not ok or not saved or saved.SizeChangeOperationId~=op.Id then
  if rejection or s.OwnershipLost then
   s.PendingItemMutation=nil
   return false,rejection or "SessionOwnershipLost"
  end
  scheduleItemMutationRetry(player,s,op)
  return false,"InventorySavePending"
 end
 s.PendingItemMutation=nil
 s.Data.SelectedSizeTier=op.Tier
 PlayerDataService.SetWin(player,s.Data.Win-op.PriceWin)
 s.Dirty=true
 player:SetAttribute("SelectedSizeTier",op.Tier)
 return true,"Success",op.Tier,s.Data.Win
end

 s.PendingItemMutation=nil

 op.Resolving=true;s.Saving=true
 local rejection
 local ok,saved=pcall(function()
  return ownedUpdate(player,s,function(old,info)
   rejection=nil
   if resetToken(old)~=op.ResetToken then rejection="SaveSupersededByReset";return nil end
   local capacity=assert(CapacityConfig.Normalize(old.InventoryCapacity))

    or egg.world(payload.EggName)~=(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld") or 1)
   or (payload.Count~=1 and payload.Count~=3 and payload.Count~=8)
   or #payload.Results~=payload.Count then return false,"InvalidPetHatch" end

    or type(result.pet)~="string" or allowed[result.pet]==nil or allowed[result.pet]~=result.percent then return false,"InvalidPetResult" end

  local result=payload.Results[1];local allowed=egg.pets(payload.EggName)
  if type(result)~="table" or type(result.id)~="string" or #result.id~=36
   or type(result.pet)~="string" or allowed[result.pet]~=result.percent or not Pet.model(result.pet) then return false,"InvalidPetResult" end
  op.Materials=preview.Ids;op.EggName=payload.EggName;op.Results=payload.Results

  or (generation or 0)~=(s.PetViewGeneration or 0) or s.StudioPetPreview~=preview then return false,"PetStateChanged" end

 if op.Resolving then return false,"InventorySavePending" end
 op.Resolving=true
 s.Saving=true
 local deltas=op.Deltas or {[op.ItemId]=op.Delta}
 local rejection

  return ownedUpdate(player,s,function(old,keyInfo)

-- The shared receipt journal remains the long-term dedupe authority.
-- A single pending intent prevents another receipt from advancing until the
-- current journal entry is Granted. Store that receipt's marker WITH its +1;
-- ordinary saves/mutations preserve it, including removal of the last copy.
-- The monotonic intent sequence also rejects a stale server resuming an older
-- grant after its lease expired and a newer receipt has already completed.
function PlayerDataService.GrantPurchasedItem(player,itemId,purchaseId,quantityVersion,intentSequence)
 local s=sessions[player]
 if not s or not s.Loaded or not s.Data then return false,"DataNotLoaded" end
 if s.Saving then return false,"DataSaving" end
 local item=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Config.ItemMaster).Get(itemId)
 if not item or (item.Rarity~="Epic" and item.Rarity~="Legendary") then return false,"InvalidItemId" end
 if typeof(purchaseId)~="string" or purchaseId=="" or #purchaseId>100 then return false,"InvalidPurchaseId" end
 if not finite(intentSequence) or intentSequence<1 or intentSequence%1~=0 then return false,"InvalidIntentSequence" end
 s.Saving=true
 local ok,saved,info=pcall(function()
  return ownedUpdate(player,s,function(old,keyInfo)
   if old~=nil and typeof(old)~="table" then error("Invalid saved PlayerData") end
   local merged=old and table.clone(old) or defaults()
   local owned=assert(normalizeItems(merged.OwnedItems))
   local users,meta=metadata(keyInfo)
   local previous=meta.ItemReceiptSequence or 0
   if intentSequence==previous then
    if meta.ItemReceiptId~=purchaseId or meta.ItemReceiptItem~=itemId then error("Receipt sequence mismatch") end
   elseif intentSequence>previous then
    local count=owned[itemId] or 0
    -- Reserved receipts created before quantity migration retain their original
    -- boolean-grant semantics; newly reserved receipts always add exactly one.
    local nextCount=quantityVersion==1 and count+1 or math.max(count,1)
    if nextCount>MAX_COUNT then error("Item count overflow") end
    owned[itemId]=nextCount
    meta.ItemReceiptId=purchaseId
    meta.ItemReceiptItem=itemId
    meta.ItemReceiptSequence=intentSequence
   end
   merged.OwnedItems=owned
   return merged,users,meta
  end)
 end)
 s.Saving=false
 if not ok or not info or (info:GetMetadata().ItemReceiptSequence or 0)<intentSequence then return false,"OwnershipSaveFailed" end
 s.Data.OwnedItems=assert(normalizeItems(saved.OwnedItems))
 s.Dirty=true
 PlayerDataService.RefreshEquipmentTutorial(player)
 return true,"Granted"
end

 if not finite(tier) or tier%1~=0 or tier<SizeChangeConfig.MinTier or tier>SizeChangeConfig.MaxTier then return false,"InvalidRequest" end
 if s.Data.RebirthCount<(config.RequiredRebirth or 5) then return false,"Locked" end
 local pending=s.PendingItemMutation
 if pending then
  if pending.SizeChange and pending.Tier==tier then return PlayerDataService.ResolveItemMutation(player) end
  return false,"DataSaving"
 end
 if s.Saving then return false,"DataSaving" end
 local current=assert(SizeChangeConfig.NormalizeSavedTier(s.Data.SelectedSizeTier))
 if current==tier then return true,"SameSize",current,s.Data.Win end
 if config.PaymentMode~="WIN" then
  if config.PaymentMode=="DEVELOPER_PRODUCT" and (config.DeveloperProductId or 0)<=0 then return false,"ProductNotConfigured" end
  return false,"PaymentUnavailable"
 end
 local price=tier==0 and 0 or config.WinPrice
 local win=s.Data.Win
 if not finite(win) or win%1~=0 or win<price then return false,"NotEnoughWin",current,win end
 s.PendingItemMutation={SizeChange=true,Id=HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
  ResetToken=s.Data.ResetToken,CurrentTier=current,Tier=tier,WinBefore=win,PriceWin=price}
 return PlayerDataService.ResolveItemMutation(player)
end

-- Free equipment selection uses the existing session/dirty-save path. Entitlement
-- authorization is performed by SpeedService; this field never grants ownership.
function PlayerDataService.SetEquippedSpeed(player,id)
 local s=sessions[player]
 if not s or not s.Loaded or not s.Data then return false,"DataNotLoaded" end
 if s.OwnershipLost then return false,"SessionOwnershipLost" end
 if id~="Normal" and id~="Premium" then return false,"InvalidRequest" end
 if s.Data.EquippedSpeed~=id then
  s.Data.EquippedSpeed=id;s.Dirty=true
  player:SetAttribute("EquippedSpeed",id)
 end
 return true,"Equipped"
end

-- Old Speed1 / 600 Win requests are retired. The client supplies only the
-- expected current stage; the server chooses the next stage and its price.
function PlayerDataService.PurchaseSpeed(player,id,currentStage)
 if id~="Upgrade" or not finite(currentStage) or currentStage%1~=0 then return false,"InvalidRequest" end
 local s=sessions[player]
 if not s or not s.Loaded or not s.Data then return false,"DataNotLoaded" end
 if s.OwnershipLost then return false,"SessionOwnershipLost" end
 local pending=s.PendingItemMutation
 if pending and pending.SpeedUpgrade and pending.CurrentStage==currentStage then
  return PlayerDataService.ResolveItemMutation(player)
 end
 if s.Saving or pending then return false,"DataSaving" end
 local stage=assert(SpeedConfig.NormalizeStage(s.Data.SpeedUpgradeStage,s.Data.OwnedSpeeds))
 if stage>=SpeedConfig.MaxUpgradeStage then return false,"MaxSpeed" end
 if currentStage~=stage then return false,"SpeedStageChanged" end
 local tier=SpeedConfig.Upgrades[stage]
 if not tier then return false,"InvalidRequest" end
 local win=s.Data.Win
 if not finite(win) or win%1~=0 or win<0 then return false,"InvalidWin" end
 if win<tier.PriceWin then return false,"NotEnoughWin" end
 s.PendingItemMutation={SpeedUpgrade=true,Id=HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
  CurrentStage=stage,NextStage=tier.NextStage,PriceWin=tier.PriceWin,
  WinBefore=win,ResetToken=s.Data.ResetToken}
 player:SetAttribute("SpeedUpgradePurchasePending",true)
 return PlayerDataService.ResolveItemMutation(player)
end

-- Server-only entry point. Client requests choose a catalogue key, never a grant.
function PlayerDataService.ClaimShopReward(player,productKey,receipt)
 -- Developer Product receipts retain their existing fulfillment path.
 if not receipt and not require(game.ServerScriptService.Services.GamePassService).AreEffectsEnabled(player) then return false,"GamePassEffectsDisabled" end
 local s=sessions[player]
 if not s or not s.Loaded or not s.Data then return false,"DataNotLoaded" end
 if s.Saving or s.PendingItemMutation then return false,"DataSaving" end
 local config
 local kind="Bundle"
 local date=dailyUTC()
 if receipt then
  if typeof(receipt)~="table" or receipt.PlayerId~=player.UserId or typeof(receipt.PurchaseId)~="string"
   or receipt.PurchaseId=="" or #receipt.PurchaseId>100 then return false,"InvalidReceipt" end
  config=ShopConfig.ForWinProduct(receipt.ProductId)
  if not config or config.Key~=productKey then return false,"InvalidProduct" end
  kind="WinReceipt"
 elseif productKey=="VIPDaily" then
  config=ShopConfig.Get("VIP").DailyBonus;kind="VIPDaily"
  if not require(game.ServerScriptService.Services.GamePassService).HasShopPass(player,"VIP") then return false,"VIPRequired" end
 else
  config=ShopConfig.Get(productKey)
  if not config or config.Kind~="GamePass" then return false,"InvalidProduct" end
  if not require(game.ServerScriptService.Services.GamePassService).HasShopPass(player,productKey) then return false,"NotOwned" end
 end
 local shop=s.Data.ShopRewards
 if kind=="VIPDaily" and shop.VIPDailyDateUTC>=date
  or kind=="Bundle" and shop.Claims[productKey]
  or kind=="WinReceipt" and shop.WinReceipts[receipt.PurchaseId] then return false,"AlreadyClaimed" end
 local amount=kind=="Bundle" and (config.WinAmount or 0) or config.Amount
 local win=player:GetAttribute("Win")
 if not finite(amount) or amount<0 or amount%1~=0 or not finite(win) or win+amount>=MAX_COUNT then return false,"InvalidWin" end
 local grant={Kind=kind,Key=productKey,Date=date,ReceiptId=receipt and receipt.PurchaseId,
  WinAmount=amount,AuraIds={},PotionExpiresUTC={}}
 if config.AuraId then table.insert(grant.AuraIds,config.AuraId) end
 if config.Potions then
  local potions=require(game.ServerScriptService.Services.PotionService)
  for id,count in pairs(config.Potions) do
   grant.PotionExpiresUTC[id]=os.time()+math.ceil(potions.GetRemaining(player,id))+TimeRewardConfig.GetPotionDuration(id)*count
  end
 end
 local deltas={}
 if config.RandomItem then
  local id=ShopConfig.RollSecret(Random.new())
  if (s.Data.OwnedItems[id] or 0)>=MAX_COUNT then return false,"CountOverflow" end
  deltas[id]=1;grant.ItemId=id
 end
 local op={Id=HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),WinPrice=0,ShopGrant=grant,
  Snapshot={Win=win,ShopWinGrantedTotal=shop.WinGrantedTotal},ResetToken=s.Data.ResetToken,Deltas=deltas}
 s.PendingItemMutation=op
 local ok,reason=PlayerDataService.ResolveItemMutation(player)
 return ok,reason,grant
end
